items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1959-07-16
items.q: The, the, the old colored fellow over here. He studied from Manuel Mineta.

ctx.x: Did you know he had any lessons around here? He studied from Manuel Mineta.

The, the, the old colored fellow over here. He studied from Manuel Mineta. And, uh, this thing on high society. You know, the, the, da, The baronet variation. Well, that's, that belongs to Manuel Mineta. Manuel Mineta, uh, created that, or whatever you want to call it. He was the first one to play it. And he taught it to Emmett. And, uh, and, uh, and he and Emmett are the only two ones that I ever heard play it that play it right. All the rest of them, and that, that includes Shark and, and all of them, all the…
